applies_why: The judge text describes weighing descent according to the flesh against conception of the Holy Ghost, which is a weighing of two chains, so K-S2's single-verse rule does not apply.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.
room: The phrase 'It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains'; I weighed whether the text is one verse's silence (K-S2 applies) or a weighing of descent according to the flesh against conception of the Holy Ghost (two chains, K-S2 does not apply).
why: Because the text expressly frames the matter as a weighing of two chains, the K-S2 exception controls and the judge did not violate the single-verse rule.
